name: Rosicrucian manifestos

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Invisible College of the Rose Cross

VINIT.justification: The undifferentiated state of the world before the revelation of the secret fraternity.

TANCH.justification: The final state of universal reformation and the closure of the Great Work.

AFWD.justification: The directed movement of the seeker toward higher knowledge and spiritual refinement.

AREV.justification: The necessary breakdown of material forms and the return to the earth for purification.

CLINK.chosen_element: The Seven Days of the Wedding
CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of initiatory stages and chemical operations.

IMSCRIB.justification: The recognition of the divine spark within the self and the macrocosm.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the prima materia into the active sulfur and passive mercury.

FFUSE.justification: The reunion of the separated principles into a unified and perfected substance.

EVALT.justification: The successful purification of the substance to the silver stage.

EVALF.justification: The rejected material that fails to undergo transmutation.

ENGAGR.justification: The hermaphroditic state where male and female principles are held in simultaneous tension.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the secret doctrine into public record and history.

phase_3.void_description: The unmanifested potential before the call of the Fama.
phase_3.true_description: The attainment of the gold and the healing of all diseases.
phase_3.false_description: The failure of the operation and the persistence of material corruption.
phase_3.both_description: The state of the initiate who lives in the world but is not of it.

steps.domain_action: The seeker exists in a state of spiritual ignorance before the discovery of the tomb.
Christian Rosenkreutz recognizes his own name and destiny within the secret history.
The journey to Damascus and Damcar begins to acquire Eastern wisdom.
The integration of mathematics, physics, and theology into a single system.
The writing of the Fama Fraternitatis to announce the existence of the order.
The invitation to the wedding forces a choice between the path of the worthy and the unworthy.
The seeker passes the scales and is found worthy to enter the royal palace.
The ascent through the seven floors of the Tower of Olympus.
The performance of the chemical operations to revive the royal couple.
The initiate sees their own reflection in the mirror of the fourth day.
The king and queen are united in the final transmutation.
The false alchemists and pretenders are cast out and punished.
The return to the world to serve as a physician and teacher in secret.
The paradox of the invisible college which is known to all but seen by none.
The publication of the Confessio to fix the laws of the fraternity in time.
The sealing of the tomb of CRC for another one hundred and twenty years.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit acting as the internal guide for the initiate.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The language of birds and the use of occult ciphers.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Vault of Brother C.R.C. containing the symbolic universe.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The cosmic cycles and the timing of the planetary conjunctions.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Book M. which contains the secrets of the universe.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The physical life and labor of the individual brother.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A world in a state of decay and religious conflict.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A world undergoing universal reformation and spiritual renewal.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy of the work is recycled through the succession of the brothers.
